title: PELOTON APP 101 - how to make the most out of the Peloton App!
description:
PELOTON APP 101 - how to make the most out of the Peloton App! Here's on overview of the Peloton app and a tutorial guide on how to use the different features in the Peloton app.

0:00 how to use the Peloton app
0:12 how to browse classes in Peloton app
0:28 how to search for class using a filter in Peloton app
0:52 how to bookmark a class in Peloton app
1:03 how to add a Peloton class to a stack 
1:24 how to schedule a class in Peloton
1:51 how to find Peloton classes you bookmarked 
2:02 how to join programs in Peloton app
3:14 How to find Peloton class collections 
3:39 how to find live classes and sign up for live Peloton classes
4:24 how to find featured Peloton classes and personalized recommendations 
4:40 how to find and join challenges in Peloton app
5:13 how to find your workout history and classes you’ve taken in Peloton app
5:35 How to get the Peloton century club shirt for free!
5:58 how to find your friends on Peloton
6:08 how to view the playlist from a Peloton class
6:34 how to share a Peloton class with a friend 
7:14 how to pause a Peloton workout 
7:18 how to change volume settings for more instructor or more music
7:31 how to cast video and AirPlay Peloton class on your tv at home
7:46 how to high five others in Peloton classes
